text:
Sam C (AP): FYI vendor 'Aurora Insights' sent invoice #2025-77 from Italy with 0% VAT and VAT ID IT12345678901. They marked reverse charge. Can tax confirm before we pay?

Nadia R (Tax): Sending this to VIES check now. Also need to confirm our EU billing entity is on the invoice. If VIES OK and it's B2B, reverse charge applies.

Sam C (AP): Attached invoice (2025-77.pdf). Our billing entity not present 94 invoice billed to Redwood Labs SL (our Spain entity) but our VAT number missing.

Leo (Vendor): We're an Italian company. We use that VAT number and typically apply reverse charge for B2B EU customers. We can add Redwood's VAT if needed.

ComplianceBot: VIES lookup IT12345678901  Result: INVALID (timestamp 2025-03-05T09:12:00Z)

Nadia R (Tax): VIES returned invalid. Could be wrong formatting or not registered. Sam, ask vendor for a copy of their Italian VAT certificate or a screenshot of the Agenzia delle Entrate entry showing the number and company name.

Sam C (AP): Asked vendor for the certificate and for them to reissue the invoice including our VAT number. I put payment on hold and flagged as TAX_VALIDATION_HOLD.

Leo (Vendor): We can supply a PDF cert but our accounting says the number is correct. They also uploaded a US W-9 earlier by mistake 94 sorry about that.

Priya S (Finance Ops): Note: W-9/W-8 are irrelevant for EU VAT. Don't let that confuse things. If they can't validate VAT, we must either get an invoice with Italian VAT charged or accept a gross-up?

Nadia R (Tax): Correct. VAT treatment isn't handled by withholding. If they can't prove VAT registration, request reissued invoice with Italian VAT (we'll reclaim via VAT return subject to rules) OR vendor can agree to a contractual gross-up where Redwood pays net + VAT amount. Gross-up needs procurement/legal and finance lead approval. Also capture any signed statement from vendor confirming B2B supply.

Sam C (AP): I'll request certificate and a firm answer on reissue vs gross-up. Payment due in 3 business days; will extend to allow docs.

Leo (Vendor): We'll try to get the cert in 48 hours and reissue if necessary. If we can't, we'll accept Redwood's gross-up terms pending PO amendment.

Nadia R (Tax): Final: Release net payment only if vendor provides an official VAT registration document matching the invoice and our VAT ID is included. Otherwise require VAT-charged invoice or an approved gross-up amendment. I'll sign off once doc received.

Sam C (AP): Thanks 94 holding payment and will update when vendor responds. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
